category_title: Students who react with aggression or outbursts when losing or frustrated
scenario_title: Reacting to minor upsetting events in the classroom
minimal_context: The student is sitting at his desk in the mainstream classroom working on an academic task.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your desk and start working on the math worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He bumped my desk! I can't work when people are bumping into me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just ignore it and focus on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Pupil x has made me angry!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still need to finish your work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes back his chair) No! (Runs out of the classroom)

task.content: General interactions and academic tasks in the mainstream classroom setting
